markingScheme.criterion: Accurately describes the pattern, quoting at least one close-planet trial and one far-planet trial (distance and orbit time) from their own Investigation Record.
markingScheme.accept: Any two genuine logged planets showing a shorter orbit at a smaller distance and a longer orbit at a greater distance.
markingScheme.insufficient: A general claim ('far planets take longer') with no actual distances/orbit times quoted from their own trials.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains that the Sun's gravity is weaker at greater distances, which causes farther planets to move more slowly.
markingScheme.accept: Equivalent wording, e.g. 'the pull is weaker further away'.

markingScheme.criterion: Also explains that farther planets have a longer path (a bigger orbit) to travel, so both weaker gravity and a longer path combine to make the orbit take longer.
markingScheme.insufficient: Mentioning only weaker gravity without the longer path, or only the longer path without weaker gravity.

markingScheme.criterion: States correctly that the new dwarf planet's year would be longer than Neptune's 165 Earth years, not shorter.
markingScheme.insufficient: Stating 'shorter', or giving no clear direction at all.

markingScheme.criterion: Links this to the same pattern found in their own Investigation Record: greater distance from the Sun means a longer orbit time.
markingScheme.accept: Referring to their own logged trials as evidence of the pattern, even without exact numbers.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains the mechanism: the greater distance means weaker gravity from the Sun and a longer path to travel, both of which make the orbit take longer.
markingScheme.insufficient: Stating the pattern (longer distance, longer year) without saying why it happens.

markingInstructions: This is a Primary 2 student, aged 9-11. Mark ONLY the two constructed responses, using each question's point-by-point marking_scheme in marking_context (award each point independently unless it names a dependsOn point, in which case only award it if that earlier point was also awarded) and each point's accept/insufficient wording. use_of_evidence's 3 marks ARE the Explain marking_scheme's 3 points, and reasoning's 3 marks ARE the Apply marking_scheme's 3 points — the rubric levels restate the same points as bands; award each set of 3 marks ONCE, not twice. communication is a separate, holistic 2 marks across both answers' clarity, never overlapping with the content marks. Copy auto_marked_score into knowledge_accuracy. Accept scientifically valid alternative wording and simple, age-appropriate phrasing. Do not penalise spelling unless meaning is unclear. Total is out of 15 (7 auto + 3 + 3 + 2). Report total, percentage, one strength, one correction, one next step, under 70 words, in warm and encouraging language suitable for a child this age.
